Name: MHA Midoriya Izuku as Toddler
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: This mod replaces the default male toddler with Izuku!
Description:
_Description_

*   This mod replaces the default male toddler with Izuku! If you're playing with [the custom NPC Toshinori Yagi](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6617) do not name your child Izuku as giving children or pets the same name as NPCs can cause bugs. Some naming suggestions include Midoriya, Midoricute or Deku. The other toddler shown is [Eri](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6320).

*   If you like this I do art commissions feel free to message me.
_Config_

*   There's an option with and without the hood, which you can change in the config file which will be generated the first time you launch the game with the mod.

*   The baby sprite for both girls and boys are the same so you can also switch off the baby sprite in config if baby Deku is no longer a crawler.
_Compatibility_

*   This mod should be compatible most mods that don't change the male toddler

*   Not currently compatible with child to NPC, I'm waiting on permissions to use those sprites as a base.

*   Should work with mobile, but it's untested because I don't have the mobile version. If you have mobile and find it works/doesn't work please let me know.
